title: The door says click.
caption: A little key opens a bigger mystery.
text: Beyond the woodland door, Ara found a pink ribbon caught on a glowcap. It was the colour of Ira’s favourite bow.
reply: And definitely not a mushroom scarf.
footnote: Every good clue deserves a little happy hop.
speaker: Ara
alt: Beyond the woodland door, Ara found a pink ribbon caught on a glowcap. It was the colour of Ira’s favourite bow.

title: A glow in the right direction.
caption: Pip had noticed something fluttery.
text: Pip had seen a little pillow following a silver butterfly. The old moon scroll might show where they went… if someone could find its three pages.
bubble: A butterfly? Ira does love those.
reply: I keep my directions on paper. Usually in one piece.
footnote: Next stop: three very shy scroll pages.
speaker: Ara
alt: Pip had seen a little pillow following a silver butterfly. The old moon scroll might show where they went… if someone could find its three pages.

title: Three pages. One promising clue.
caption: The moon scroll shines again.
text: The rebuilt scroll showed a brook, a bridge and a tiny cottage under the moon. Ara traced the route with one careful paw.
bubble: A cottage! Could Ira be there?
reply: Let’s ask the brook. It’s excellent at running.
footnote: The map was old. The hope was brand new.
speaker: Ara
alt: The rebuilt scroll showed a brook, a bridge and a tiny cottage under the moon. Ara traced the route with one careful paw.

title: The bridge has a small problem.
caption: Small, if you happen to have wings.
text: On the bank, Ara found another ribbon and a bridge with its middle missing. Bramble was already counting useful pieces of driftwood.
bubble: Ira, I hope you took the dry route.
reply: Three bundles should do it. Plus a little enthusiasm.
footnote: Panda paws prefer bridges to puddles.
speaker: Ara
alt: On the bank, Ara found another ribbon and a bridge with its middle missing. Bramble was already counting useful pieces of driftwood.

title: Four paws across.
caption: A sturdy bridge and a very proud hedgehog.
text: The repaired bridge gave a happy creak. On the far bank, a pink ribbon fluttered beneath a sky full of sleepy stars.
bubble: We did it! Ira came this way.
reply: Official bridge test: no soggy socks.
footnote: Bramble had not actually brought socks.
speaker: Ara
alt: The repaired bridge gave a happy creak. On the far bank, a pink ribbon fluttered beneath a sky full of sleepy stars.

title: A frog’s extremely helpful answer.
caption: Ara asked everyone. Even this fellow.
text: “Have you seen a pillow?” Ara asked. The frog said “Ribbit.” Then a star winked over the hollow, where Moss was waiting with a much better clue.
bubble: Was that a yes or a no?
footnote: Some witnesses are better at hopping than talking.
speaker: Ara
alt: “Have you seen a pillow?” Ara asked. The frog said “Ribbit.” Then a star winked over the hollow, where Moss was waiting with a much better clue.

title: The stars leave a light on.
caption: Moon. Star. Heart. Home.
text: The awakened stones drew a shining trail toward a cottage. Moss pointed to something pink in the garden. Ara’s lantern gave a hopeful shimmer.
reply: The moonflowers know her favourite tune.
footnote: One last little kindness would wake the garden.
speaker: Ara
alt: The awakened stones drew a shining trail toward a cottage. Moss pointed to something pink in the garden. Ara’s lantern gave a hopeful shimmer.

title: Meanwhile, one very patient pillow.
caption: Ira was safe. And a little sleepy.
text: The silver butterfly had led Ira to a warm cottage. Now she waited among the moonflowers, listening for the lullaby Ara always hummed at bedtime.
bubble: Ara will find me. She always does.
reply: Next time, I’m following a biscuit.
footnote: A familiar tune. A familiar hug. Almost home.
speaker: Ira
alt: The silver butterfly had led Ira to a warm cottage. Now she waited among the moonflowers, listening for the lullaby Ara always hummed at bedtime.
